intro: Tourism, farming and citizenship sales support Vanuatu's economy.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Kava, copra, beef and cocoa are exported. Tourists visit by cruise ship and air. Many ni-Vanuatu do seasonal farm work in Australia and New Zealand.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Vanuatu makes and sells to the world.
